features.casting-management: Kitsu gives every shot a structured casting breakdown, so scene builders know what is ready, what is missing and what to do next, with no email digging.
features.elite-hosting: A dedicated Kitsu instance hosted on OVH in the EU or your region, run end to end by CGWire: security, uptime, performance and updates handled for you.
features.production-tracker: Scheduling, time tracking, quota monitoring and budget forecasting in Kitsu, to catch production issues early and bring accurate data to every meeting.
features.review-engine: Centralize reviews in Kitsu: precise, contextual feedback on every submission from teams and clients, with versions, decisions and history kept together.
features.studio-database: Kitsu's HTTP API makes every asset, shot, task and assignment queryable from any tool in your studio, so your pipeline talks to a single place.
features.tailor-made-architecture: CGWire deploys and runs Kitsu on your hardware or an isolated cloud, for studios that need data sovereignty, strict access control and production isolation.
features.team-collaboration: Kitsu brings tasks, previews and feedback into one workflow, so artists, supervisors and directors work from the same source of truth, on site or remote.
features.top-notch-support: Answers in 30 minutes on average through in-app chat, from a team of former production managers. Every conversation is saved and tracked.
